exposure: Screening with Continuous wave Doppler ultrasound of the umbilical artery (CWDU-UmA)
Management according to a standardised protocol for foetuses identified with an abnormal CWDU-UmA test
cohort: Pregnant women attending primary health care clinics in South Africa, screened at 28-34 weeks gestation.
finding: Screening a low-risk pregnant population using CWDU-UmA and subsequent management was associated with a significant reduction (35% - 43%) in stillbirths.
